description: Unit-variance white noise in g, catalog bearing 6205

diagnose_vibration.overall_diagnosis: ISO Severity: Zone D (Unacceptable) — RMS velocity 5.84 mm/s. Dominant frequency: 5896.0 Hz (shaft: 29.9 Hz). Bearing analysis: No eligible line at a tested characteristic frequency stands above the local noise floor in this record and band. This is not evidence that the bearing is free of defects. Combined evidence across the analyses that ran: moderate. It counts findings, is not a probability, and does not identify or confirm a fault type.
recommendations: IMMEDIATE ACTION: Stop machine and inspect.

generate_diagnostic_report.verdict: No eligible line at a tested characteristic frequency stands above the local noise floor in this record and band. This is not evidence that the bearing is free of defects. Broadband vibration is elevated (Zone D), and the envelope evidence names no bearing fault type, so bearing and non-bearing sources both remain possible.
generate_diagnostic_report.evidence_strength_note: Evidence strength counts the findings of the analyses that ran, a bearing finding once. It is not a confidence score, it is not a probability, and it does not identify or confirm a fault type.

Envelope line test for bearing 6205 at 29.9 Hz shaft speed. The outer-race line (BPFO) does not stand above the local noise floor in this record and band. The cage line (FTF) does not stand above the local noise floor in this record and band.

The largest share of STFT energy is in the 2000-5000 Hz band (49% of the total). This percentage describes the measured signal and does not identify a fault. The relative distribution across frequency bands can change with the measured physical quantity (for example, acceleration versus velocity).

Envelope spectrum with the FTF, BPFO, BSF and BPFI search windows overlaid. Each shaded band is the ±5% window around the line its check tests (2 x BSF for the rolling element). A peak inside a window is not a finding by itself: the check counts a line only when it stands above the local noise floor and a further line it predicts does too. No window is emphasised: the bearing statement in this report names no candidate line.
